observations: Photo 0 shows a white electric sewing machine wrapped in clear plastic.
The machine has a blue butterfly logo and decorative snowflake patterns on the front panel.
The brand name 'butterfly' and model 'JH8190' are visible on a sticker on the front, below the plastic wrap.
A black power adapter is placed in front of the machine, coiled and connected to a cable.
The machine appears to be sitting on a cardboard box or surface, with a plain wall in the background.
The plastic wrap is slightly crumpled and has some dust or debris on it, suggesting it may not be brand new or has been handled.

claims.claim: Brand New Butterfly Electric Sewing Machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows plastic wrap, but it is dusty and crumpled; no proof of original packaging or seal. The machine may have been used or handled.
Photo 0 shows the brand 'butterfly' and model 'JH8190' on a sticker on the front of the machine.

risks.risk: The machine may not be brand new or may have been used before.
risks.proof: A photo of the original box with seal intact, or a video showing the machine being unboxed and powered on for the first time.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used or second-hand, not brand new

risks.risk: The power adapter may not be original or may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the adapter's label showing voltage, amperage, and brand, or a video of it plugged in and working.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly non-functional or with unknown compatibility

risks.risk: The machine may be missing accessories (e.g., bobbins, needles, foot pedal, manual).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or missing parts

proof_requests: Photo of the original box with seal intact.
Close-up of the power adapter label.
Photo of all accessories included with the machine.
Video of the machine being powered on and sewing a test stitch.
response.reason: The model and brand are confirmed, but the 'brand new' claim is unverified due to the condition of the plastic wrap and lack of original packaging. Risks include possible prior use, missing accessories, and non-original adapter. Proof is needed to confirm condition and completeness before pricing.
